oral_examination.oral_examination: 25 residual crowns, suspected root canal filling material can be seen, the texture is soft by percussion (-), the defect reaches 2mm subgingivally, and there is no abnormality in the buccal mucosa. The rest are no different. 11 and 21 are mesioproximal caries. No probing pain, nothing else.

treatment_plan.definitive: After removal, the transplantation was postponed and resin filling was performed on 11 and 21 days.
treatment_plan.notes: Follow-up for discomfort. Maintain oral hygiene and rinse your mouth with mouthwash. Oral antibiotics (bring your own).
